EVENT LOG

Model boundaries

Each fly carries a compact recurrent neural controller. Two parents pass starting traits and network genes to offspring; acquired weight changes are not copied. Mutation can add or remove neurons and connections. Founders begin with a disclosed food-seeking reflex—scaffolding for viability, not an evolved finding.

Accounting and full-connectome status

This observatory does not run the 166,700-neuron biological fly connectome; the MaleCNS arena runs locally from the v3 release via npm start. Simulation seconds are artificial units, and reward-modulated Hebbian weight updates are a candidate rule rather than established general learning.
